# garage_layout_node (Resource)

Manages a node's role in the Garage cluster layout. Changes are staged and applied (two-phase commit).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "garage_layout_node" "node1" {
  node_id  = data.garage_cluster_status.current.nodes[0].id
  zone     = "dc1"
  capacity = 1073741824  # 1 GiB
  tags     = ["storage", "fast"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node_id` (String) 64-character hex node identifier.
- `zone` (String) Zone name for the node.

### Optional

- `capacity` (Number) Storage capacity in bytes. Null for gateway nodes.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for the node.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Node identifier (same as node_id).
- `layout_version` (Number) Layout version after the last apply.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import garage_layout_node.node1 <64-char-hex-node-id>
```
